title: A template kit whose packed 1440 shots lack a current look reads kit-incomplete; writing looks keeps the approval
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/template-kit.test.mjs
S2: Read the line for the test whose name starts with 'every 1440 shot needs a current look'.
expect: That test reports ok: a kit with a packed 1440 shot and no look (or a look whose sha256 is not the shot's) reads kit-incomplete with params.missingLooks naming it as missing or stale; once every shot has a current look the step reads kit-approved again, with the same approval.
evidence: Measured 03/11/2026: the committed JA Boxing 1.0.10 kit had no looks; after cli.mjs looks --apply, looks --list reports 0 shots without a current look.
fence: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/template-kit/reader.js looksMissingOf and road-step.js judge looks after the template gaps and before the approval.

tests: every 1440 shot needs a current look
